Sources, estimates & how we score

How we score

Score = (power ÷ asking price in ETH) × [1 + 0.25 if it merges with yours today − 0.10 if it must leave staking first]. The adjustments are additive. A Squeek with both gets ×1.15.

A best pick needs a positive price for every available candidate. Zero or missing prices are unranked. Ties are shown as ties. This measures power for your stated price, not a market price or a return on investment. Your existing merge partner’s cost and network fees are not included.

Squeeks already owned or deposited by your loaded wallet stay out of the purchase ranking. The comparison and merge information remain available.

What the reward share means

Base power × 10¹⁸ ÷ (total NFT power + total SQK power). The current API reports pool power with 18 decimal places and base power as whole units. For a wallet-held Squeek, this is an estimate once deposited, at the current pool composition. Depositing adds power to the pool; other deposits, withdrawals and policy changes can change the share. The “per 1,000 SQK” figure applies to staking rewards distributed, not all SQK minted.

Cooldown days are an estimate: Squeek blocks remaining ÷ (completed Squeek blocks over 7 days ÷ 7). Rest and zero-work periods stay in the denominator. It can take longer when Squeektoshi rests. No future SQK per day is promised.

Where the reads come from

  • Economy API: pool totals, release, contract identities and policy.
  • Squeek API: image, traits, level, base power, custody and cooldown. Each card links its own endpoint.
  • 7-day settlements: completed blocks including rest periods.
  • Optional account API: all pages of owned and deposited Squeeks, used only to find merge partners.
  • Published deployment compared with API identities before any contract read.
  • Public Sepolia RPC: SqueekMining weightForLevel(0, level), cooldownBlocks(0, level), position(0, id), plus SqueekNFT ownerOf(id) and tokenURI(id), only when contract identities match.

API snapshots are at a safe block with 12 confirmations and may be cached for 5 seconds. Independent endpoint reads can span safe blocks; their blocks and times remain visible. Unknown data is never treated as zero. Refresh before a trade. No tracking, cookies or stored wallet address; public services receive your read requests.
